احتقرتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرْتُنَّ (iḥtaqartunna) /iħ.ta.qar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرْتُنَّ (uḥtuqirtunna) /uħ.tu.qir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
